shoppingGuide.title: FASHORA SHOPPING GUIDE
shoppingGuide.subtitle: A seamless guide to discovering and acquiring curated bespoke garments from premier independent ateliers.
shoppingGuide.keyNote: Every garment on FASHORA is independently handcrafted and finished by curated independent ateliers, guaranteeing distinct artisanal craftsmanship and rigorous pre-dispatch inspection.

steps.title: EXPLORE RUNWAY COLLECTIONS & ATELIERS
steps.desc: Browse diverse silhouettes across SET, SHIRT, and PANTS, or immerse in atelier origins via the Explore editorial feed. Utilize precision search and category filters to curate selections matching your aesthetic.
steps.tips: Tip: Follow ateliers (Follow Shop) to gain priority access to limited seasonal drops.

steps.title: CONSULT THE PRECISION SIZE MATRIX
steps.desc: Each bespoke piece includes detailed millimeter-accurate garment specifications (chest, waist, hip, length). Click 'SIZE MATRIX' on any product page to align your proportions before adding to bag.
steps.tips: Keep a measuring tape handy to measure your chest and back length for an impeccable drape.

steps.title: CART REVIEW & REAL-TIME ALLOCATION
steps.desc: Review selected garments, adjust quantities, and verify colors. Our system atomically checks live atelier workshop stock to guarantee precise inventory allocation without backorders.
steps.tips: Artisanal batches are produced in limited quantities. Finalize checkout early to secure your piece.

steps.title: FLEXIBLE & SECURE PAYMENT CHANNELS
steps.desc: FASHORA accommodates 3 frictionless payment methods: Cash on Delivery (COD), fee-free instant VietQR banking transfer, or 256-bit encrypted international credit/debit card processing.
steps.tips: VietQR payments are verified automatically by the platform within 30 seconds without screenshot uploads.

steps.title: DISPATCH TRACKING & WHITE-GLOVE ARRIVAL
steps.desc: Track real-time packaging, fulfillment, and transit progress in 'My Orders'. Standard nationwide delivery spans 2-4 business days, housed inside protective luxury editorial packaging.
steps.tips: You are entitled to external parcel inspection alongside delivery personnel prior to acceptance.

exchangePolicy.title: EXCHANGE & RETURN POLICY
exchangePolicy.subtitle: Transparent, client-first return directives with a flexible 14-day atelier satisfaction window.
exchangePolicy.keyNote: To ensure an uncompromising luxury experience, FASHORA provides flexible size exchanges, model replacements, or complete refunds for all garments meeting inspection criteria.

articles.title: 14-DAY SATISFACTION WINDOW
articles.desc: Clients are entitled to initiate size adjustments, exchanges, or returns within 14 calendar days from confirmed postal delivery (grounded on certified carrier timestamps).

articles.title: GARMENT ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA
articles.desc: Returned garments must strictly fulfill all of the following requirements:
bullets: Intact FASHORA security tags, atelier provenance seals, and all spare hardware/buttons attached.
Original pristine condition: unwashed, unworn, unaltered, free from fragrance, makeup, or external blemishes.
Delivered with original branded luxury boxes and garment dust bags undamaged.

articles.title: ZERO-COST COMPLIMENTARY EXCHANGES
articles.desc: FASHORA assumes 100% of two-way courier shipping costs in occurrences involving:
bullets: Craftsmanship defects originating from the atelier (stitching flaws, fabric blemishes, zipper malfunctions).
Fulfillment discrepancies such as incorrect item dispatch, wrong size, or mismatched colorway.

articles.title: ATOMIC RESTOCKING & REFUND REVERSAL
articles.desc: Upon authorized return approval, returned units are atomically restocked into the atelier workshop inventory. Approved refunds are credited directly to your designated bank account within 24-48 business hours following quality inspection.

privacyPolicy.title: PRIVACY & DATA PROTECTION POLICY
privacyPolicy.subtitle: Safeguarding your personal information with industry-leading 256-bit cybersecurity standards.
privacyPolicy.keyNote: At FASHORA, your privacy is paramount. We safeguard your identity through state-of-the-art cryptographic architecture across all shopping and merchant interactions.

articles.title: INFORMATION WE COLLECT
articles.desc: We exclusively gather essential data necessary to deliver your tailored garments:
bullets: Identity credentials: Full legal name, date of birth, gender selection.
Contact & shipping details: Mobile number, verified delivery address, email address.
Interaction history: Completed orders, followed ateliers, saved wishlist items.

articles.title: PURPOSE OF DATA UTILIZATION
articles.desc: Collected client data is applied strictly toward transparent operational purposes:
bullets: Order routing and direct fulfillment coordination with our independent ateliers.
Generating secure ephemeral OTP verification codes for account recovery and credential updates.
Transmitting dispatch notifications and shipment tracking updates via email or SMS.
Refining personalized fashion recommendations aligned with your aesthetic preferences.

articles.title: ABSOLUTE CONFIDENTIALITY & ZERO DATA SALES
articles.desc: FASHORA enforces an uncompromising zero-sale policy: personal records are never leased, sold, or shared with third-party ad brokers for marketing spam. Data in transit is secured with 256-bit SSL encryption.

articles.title: YOUR AUTONOMY & CONTROL RIGHTS
articles.desc: You retain unconditional authority over your personal footprint:
bullets: Freely review and update personal profile details, phone numbers, and avatars in My Profile.
Reset your password at any moment using secure randomized 6-digit OTP verification.
Request permanent account termination and associated record deletion at any time.

termsOfUse.title: TERMS OF USE & SERVICE AGREEMENT
termsOfUse.subtitle: Universal legal conditions governing participation in the FASHORA bespoke fashion ecosystem.
termsOfUse.keyNote: By accessing the platform or placing orders with our ateliers, you acknowledge and accept all provisions and quality charters outlined herein.

articles.title: ECOSYSTEM NATURE & ATELIER INTEGRITY
articles.desc: FASHORA operates as a curated digital marketplace connecting independent ateliers with discerning fashion patrons. Every artisan and atelier undergoes strict portfolio review and quality vetting before offering garments on the platform.

articles.title: UNIFIED SINGLE-ACCOUNT POLICY (2-IN-1)
articles.desc: FASHORA implements a unified credential architecture:
bullets: Members utilize one single account for both customer purchases and atelier management upon completing Seller Onboarding.
Users maintain sole accountability for guarding account credentials, passwords, and actions conducted under their identity.

articles.title: INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY & ARTISTIC ASSETS
articles.desc: All campaign runway lookbooks, video editorials, curated fashion critiques in Explore, and the FASHORA brand trademark constitute protected intellectual property of FASHORA and affiliated ateliers. Unauthorized commercial copying or automated data scraping is strictly prohibited.

articles.title: PRICING AUTHENTICITY & ORDER INTEGRITY
articles.desc: Listed prices are officially cataloged in Vietnamese Dong (VND). FASHORA reserves the explicit right to refuse or cancel orders showing indicators of speculative arbitrage, bot automated transactions, or commercial exploitation.
